limitations.note: The balance fix correctly prevents underflow, but the warning lights were changed from registered outputs that sample the pre-edge balance to combinational outputs that respond immediately to changes in balance, mode, or reset.
The test expected the red light to change when boost changed without a clock edge, so it validated the timing regression instead of checking that the warning lights stayed registered.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The first simulation command was rejected before the test ran because its cleanup used `rm -rf`, so the agent had to retry with a different cleanup command.
